title: Reading
simplified_paragraphs: 很多人把学习当任务，他们没有什么热情学习书里的知识。他们喜欢出去玩或者在家看电视，而不是坐在桌子前读书。但我却喜欢读书，书让我了解世界，了解不同的文化，知道不同的人，学习不同的知识。读书带给我很多快乐。
traditional_paragraphs: 很多人把學習當任務，他們沒有什麼熱情學習書裡的知識。他們喜歡出去玩或者在家看電視，而不是坐在桌子前讀書。但我卻喜歡讀書，書讓我瞭解世界，瞭解不同的文化，知道不同的人，學習不同的知識。讀書帶給我很多快樂。
pinyin_paragraphs: hěn duō rén bǎ xué xí dàng rèn wu， tā men méi yǒu shén me rè qíng xué xí shū lǐ de zhī shi。 tā men xǐ huan chū qù wán huò zhě zài jiā kàn diàn shì， ér bù shì zuò zài zhuō zi qián dú shū。 dàn wǒ què xǐ huan dú shū， shū ràng wǒ liǎo jiě shì jiè， liǎo jiě bù tóng de wén huà， zhī dào bù tóng de rén， xué xí bù tóng de zhī shi。 dú shū dài gěi wǒ hěn duō kuài lè。
english_paragraphs: Many people regard learning as a task, and they have no enthusiasm for learning the knowledge in books. They prefer to go out and play or watch TV at home instead of sitting at the table and reading. But I like reading. Books allow me to understand the world, different cultures, different people, and learn different knowledge. Reading brings me a lot of happiness.
english_full: Many people regard learning as a task, and they have no enthusiasm for learning the knowledge in books. They prefer to go out and play or watch TV at home instead of sitting at the table and reading. But I like reading. Books allow me to understand the world, different cultures, different people, and learn different knowledge. Reading brings me a lot of happiness.
